targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ttft_ms AS ttft_p95 FROM (
  SELECT t.ttft_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.ttft_ms) AS n, count(*) OVER () AS timed
  FROM traces t WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%') AND t.ttft_ms IS NOT NULL)
WHERE n = (95 * timed + 99) / 100

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT coalesce(coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model), '(none)') AS model, t.outcome, t.ttft_ms, t.output_tps,
         t.output_tokens, t.cache_read_tokens, t.input_tokens_total, t.cost_usd,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) ORDER BY t.ttft_ms IS NULL, t.ttft_ms) AS n,
         count(t.ttft_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model)) AS timed
  FROM traces t
  WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%'))
SELECT model,
       count(*) AS requests,
       avg(outcome != 'ok') AS error_ratio,
       max(CASE WHEN n = (50 * timed + 99) / 100 THEN ttft_ms END) AS ttft_p50_ms,
       max(CASE WHEN n = (95 * timed + 99) / 100 THEN ttft_ms END) AS ttft_p95_ms,
       avg(output_tps) AS mean_output_tps,
       sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
       1.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / sum(input_tokens_total) AS cache_hit_ratio,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM r
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT max((t.started_at / 86400000) * 86400, $__from / 1000) AS time,
       coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) AS series,
       sum(t.cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM traces t
WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%') AND t.cost_usd IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT substr(t.session_id, 1, 8) AS session,
       count(*) AS requests,
       min(t.started_at) / 1000.0 AS first,
       max(t.started_at + t.duration_ms) - min(t.started_at) AS span_ms,
       group_concat(DISTINCT coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model)) AS models,
       sum(t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
       1.0 * sum(t.cache_read_tokens) / sum(t.input_tokens_total) AS cache_hit_ratio,
       sum(t.cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM traces t
WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%') AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.session_id
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 20

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t.outcome, t.error_type, t.http_status, count(*) AS requests, max(t.started_at) / 1000.0 AS last
FROM traces t
WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%') AND t.outcome != 'ok'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Recent requests

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t.started_at / 1000.0 AS time,
       t.upstream,
       coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) AS model,
       t.outcome,
       t.stop_reason,
       t.ttft_ms,
       t.duration_ms,
       t.input_tokens_total AS input,
       t.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read,
       t.output_tokens AS output,
       t.cost_usd,
       t.session_id AS session,
       t.captured,
       lower(hex(coalesce(t.otel_trace_id, t.id))) AS trace
FROM traces t
WHERE t.started_at >= $__from AND t.started_at < $__to AND ('${upstream:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${upstream:csv},' LIKE '%,' || t.upstream || ',%') AND ('${model:csv}' = '.*' OR ',${model:csv},' LIKE '%,' || coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ',%')
ORDER BY t.started_at DESC
LIMIT 100
